name: T1
summary: Booster T1 is a humanoid robot from Booster Robotics, made for developers. Booster states it is shipping worldwide and is used by 50+ robotics teams and research institutes.
specs_note: Commercial maturity COMMERCIAL recorded 2026-10-04 (owner decision, six-robot review). Basis: manufacturer states it is now shipping worldwide, with institutional customers. Selected specifications retrieved from first-party manufacturer documentation on 2026-10-22 under HO-DATA-02B. Evidence status: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH; not human-verified. Remaining specifications are unknown unless separately documented. SPECIFICATIONS (HO-DATA-02B, 2026-10-22): height, weight, whole-body DoF, walking speed and endurance from the specifications chapter of Booster's own T1 product manual https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/product-manual/t1/getting-started/specifications/ (the booster.tech marketing site no longer shows a T1 page). The manual's single table covers both T1 editions (Basic and Standard differ only in compute). Payload is not stated there and stays UNKNOWN; battery Wh is not stated ('48V 10.5Ah' only) and is not derived. use_case_fits.notes: Booster's product page presents the T1 as 'Made for Developers' (https://www.booster.tech/booster-t1/, observed 2026-10-04).
use_case_fits.limitations: Specifications, SDK, ROS and simulation support are not yet verified in this catalogue. The page's statement that the T1 is the choice of 50+ robotics teams and research institutes is made in the context of the RoboCup Soccer AdultSize category, not general research adoption. No availability offer is recorded.

use_case_fits.notes: Booster's product page ties the T1 to the RoboCup Soccer AdultSize category: a competition platform, and a potential demonstration platform (https://www.booster.tech/booster-t1/).
use_case_fits.limitations: A robot-soccer competition context, not a purpose-built entertainment product. Demonstrations or exhibitions are a potential use, not an established event-service capability. Specifications are not yet verified.

spec_caveats.text: Booster's T1 product manual states '高（站直） 1.18m' (standing upright); 118 cm is a unit conversion.
Booster states '约 30kg' (approximately 30 kg); whether the battery is included is not stated.
Booster states '全身自由度 23' (whole-body DoF): 6 per leg, 4 per arm (marked expandable, '4（可拓展）'), 1 waist, 2 head.
Booster states '行走速度 1m/s' (walking speed); test conditions are not given.
Booster states '续航 2h' (battery endurance); conditions are not given. 120 min is a unit conversion.
Booster Robotics states '单侧腿（6 个自由度）' / '全向行走 ：支持前向、后向、侧向行走，以及旋转和复合行走。' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/product-manual/t1/getting-started/overview/).
Booster Robotics states '深度相机、麦克风阵列、扬声器都在头部。' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/product-manual/t1/getting-started/overview/).
Booster Robotics states '机型 Booster K1 / T1 / T2' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/developer-guide/booster-os-python-sdk/sdk-overview/).
Booster Robotics states '并下发模式切换、速度控制、关节控制、动作、轨迹和音频播放等指令' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/developer-guide/booster-os-python-sdk/sdk-overview/).
Booster Robotics states 'ROS 2 节点与 Booster Robotics SDK 应用可以和 Booster 系统服务 互通' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/developer-guide/cpp/sdk-overview/).
Booster Robotics states 'T1 (23 DoF)' / '23 自由度布局：头部 2、双臂各 4、腰部 1、双腿各 6 个关节。' / 'robots/T1/T1_23dof.urdf' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/developer-guide/open-source/booster-assets/).
Booster Robotics states 'Hi Chat ：支持语音对话' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/product-manual/t1/getting-started/overview/).
Booster Robotics states '开机后等待约 1 分钟，机器人播放提示音，即可被遥控。' (https://docs.booster.tech/zh-CN/docs/product-manual/t1/getting-started/quick-start/).
